title: Ambiguous/unresolved ownership: separate from clean coverage and resolve by source structure
description:
SCOPE (registry row ambiguous-coverage, alias indep:009; plan B2 "resolve all 187 ambiguous and 75 unresolved ownership entries" + A5 "coverage reports separate classified, resolved, ambiguous, unresolved, excluded").
Live (c53ba040) source-coverage.json: summary.ambiguous=187 entries with status "ambiguous:<k1>|<k2>..." (resolution.kind ambiguous-normalized-name, e.g. Barbarian "Hit Points"/"Proficiencies"/"Equipment" headings matched to generic rule:* keys); diagnostics.unresolvedOwnership=75, suspiciousOwnership=55. unaccounted=0 today, i.e. ambiguous counts as accounted.
Required invariants: (1) an ambiguous/unresolved entry never counts toward clean coverage - the gate reports it separately and fails unless it carries a reviewed disposition; (2) resolve ownership by source structure (section/context path), so e.g. class "Hit Points" under Barbarian > Class Features resolves to the class-owned record/field, not a name match. Denominator = source inventory entries (source-derived).
Likely the largest child; may split further (gate first, then resolution by family).
